name: Trial Site
description: he physical or virtual location where trial-related activities are conducted and where the patient interacts with the clinical team.

name: Adverse Event (AE)
description: Any untoward medical occurrence in a patient or clinical investigation subject administered a pharmaceutical product, regardless of causal relationship.

name: Active Participant
description: A patient who has successfully passed the screening phase and is currently receiving treatment or being observed within a clinical trial.

name: Informed Consent Date
description: The specific date a patient signs the legal document agreeing to the risks and procedures of a trial; often the first "event" in the patient journey.
